say:2:1421408001:1.text: Well, well. Look who's finally here! Did you see my great performance?
say:2:1421408001:1.source_cn: 总算来了啊，二位，看到我刚刚大展身手的英姿了吗？

say:3:1421408002:1.text: What were we supposed to see? <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were doing the fighting while you stood there with your arms folded.
say:3:1421408002:1.male: What were we supposed to see? <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were doing the fighting while you stood there with your arms folded.
say:3:1421408002:1.female: What were we supposed to see? <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were doing the fighting while you stood there with your arms folded.

say:5:1421408003:1.text: Ah, my bad. Next time, I'll make sure to cheer you on from the sidelines.
say:5:1421408003:1.source_cn: 抱歉，下次我会记得给你大声加油的。

say:6:1421408004:1.text: Hmm. You seem like you're in a good mood. Why?
say:6:1421408004:1.source_cn: 总之，我记得你以前不会因为对付一个混混就这么沾沾自喜。

say:7:1421408005:1.text: I'm celebrating the proof of my judgment! I knew someone would eventually try to steal from the pool. It was only a matter of time.
say:7:1421408005:1.source_cn: 我当然不是因为战斗本身而愉快，而是因为这证明了我的判断...

say:8:1421408006:1.text: But Ravion, the curse drives people mad. If that's why they did it, shouldn't you show some mercy?
say:8:1421408006:1.source_cn: 是因为诅咒发作吗？孽化多少会让人失去理智，如果是这样，...

say:9:1421408007:1.source_cn: 噢？这种心慈手软的发言可不像你会说的台词啊。

say:10:1421408008:1.text: But think about it—this isn't just some desperate fool.
say:10:1421408008:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，开玩笑的，放心吧，我有分寸，如果真的情有可原，...

say:11:1421408009:1.text: The hidden Divine Dew pool in the Temple of Helthor isn't common knowledge.
say:11:1421408009:1.source_cn: 只不过，我是不觉得能打探到“赫托神殿里有个隐秘的灵露池...

say:12:1421408010:1.text: The temple itself is a secret, let alone the pool.
say:12:1421408010:1.source_cn: 毕竟连这个神殿的存在目前还是被严格保密的，更别说灵露池...

say:13:1421408011:1.text: Whoever found it, navigated the obstacles, and dared to steal from it...
say:13:1421408011:1.source_cn: 要是有人打探到情报，还坚持跋山涉水历经千辛万苦走这——...

say:14:1421408012:1.text: That's exactly the kind of person I was watching for.
say:14:1421408012:1.source_cn: 我是觉得这坚韧不拔的身子骨就算被我揍个好几顿，应该也会...

say:15:1421408013:1.text: I'm not slow, Ravion. You don't have to spell it out for me.
say:15:1421408013:1.source_cn: ……我知道是我想得太简单了，你不用这么拐弯抹角。

say:16:1421408014:1.text: Oh? And here I thought I was helping you understand!
say:16:1421408014:1.source_cn: 我可是考虑到你的心情才专门使用了更委婉的话术来解释，没...

choice_prompt:17:1421408014.text: Oh? And here I thought I was helping you understand!
choice_prompt:17:1421408014.source_cn: 我可是考虑到你的心情才专门使用了更委婉的话术来解释，没想到你还是在第六句的时候反应过来了，有进步！

say:18:1421408015:1.text: Hahaha, I can't help it—Indris makes it too easy sometimes.
say:18:1421408015:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈，抱歉抱歉，毕竟因度厄这家伙很好玩，我会忍不住...
say:18:1421408015:1.male: Hahaha, I can't help it—Indris makes it too easy sometimes.
say:18:1421408015:1.female: Hahaha, I can't help it—Indris makes it too easy sometimes.

say:19:1421408017:1.text: And Indris isn't entirely wrong—people haven't run out of Divine Dew yet, so we haven't seen the worst of it.
say:19:1421408017:1.source_cn: 不过，因度厄的担忧也不是杞人忧天，只是目前治疗孽化的进...
say:19:1421408017:1.male: And Indris isn't entirely wrong—people haven't run out of Divine Dew yet, so we haven't seen the worst of it.
say:19:1421408017:1.female: And Indris isn't entirely wrong—people haven't run out of Divine Dew yet, so we haven't seen the worst of it.

say:20:1421408018:1.text: But if the corruption keeps spreading unchecked, it's only a matter of time before there are victims. And when that happens, their families will start looking for answers.
say:20:1421408018:1.source_cn: 但如果不能尽快治疗完诅咒，总有一天会有受害者或者他们的...
say:20:1421408018:1.male: But if the corruption keeps spreading unchecked, it's only a matter of time before there are victims. And when that happens, their families will start looking for answers.
say:20:1421408018:1.female: But if the corruption keeps spreading unchecked, it's only a matter of time before there are victims. And when that happens, their families will start looking for answers.

say:21:1421408019:1.text: At this point, the essence pool isn't exactly a secret anymore.
say:21:1421408019:1.source_cn: 毕竟现在蛋液池的存在也不能完全说是秘密了。

say:22:1421408020:1.text: I might've let it slide if it were just one or two people. But if more start coming... that's when things get dangerous.
say:22:1421408020:1.source_cn: 如果只有一两个人，我还能睁一眼闭一眼，但如果人多了，问...

say:23:1421408021:1.text: I understand. I'll urge the priests and priestesses to speed up their research of the curse.
say:23:1421408021:1.source_cn: 我知道了，我会去监督，尽量让他们加快进度的。

say:24:1421408022:1.text: Don't look so serious, Indris. With <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the Sylvan Tendril on our side, we'll definitely figure it out. We have time.
say:24:1421408022:1.male: Don't look so serious, Indris. With <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the Sylvan Tendril on our side, we'll definitely figure it out. We have time.
say:24:1421408022:1.female: Don't look so serious, Indris. With <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the Sylvan Tendril on our side, we'll definitely figure it out. We have time.

say:25:1421408023:1.text: Besides, the thieves I've caught so far aren't your average desperate souls. They're from respectable backgrounds, with strong faith and ties to the more "noble" parts of society.
say:25:1421408023:1.source_cn: 就目前为止的经验来看，被我逮捕的都是当年出身不错，信仰...

choice_prompt:26:1421408023.text: Besides, the thieves I've caught so far aren't your average desperate souls. They're from respectable backgrounds, with strong faith and ties to the more "noble" parts of society.
choice_prompt:26:1421408023.source_cn: 就目前为止的经验来看，被我逮捕的都是当年出身不错，信仰虔诚，更“高贵”的那部分人。

say:27:1421408024:2.text: As I said, you need more than desperation to pull something like this off.
say:27:1421408024:2.source_cn: 嗯，无法排除生理欲求驱使的疯狂，但还是我前头说过的，要...

say:29:1421408026:1.text: To them, even if this wasn't Divine Dew but just regular water, if you told them the Queen and High Priestess had bathed here...

say:29:1421408026:1.female: To them, even if this wasn't Divine Dew but just regular water, if you told them the Queen and High Priestess had bathed here...

say:30:1421408027:1.source_cn: 他们多半也会感激涕零地一饮而尽吧。
say:30:1421408027:1.male: They'd probably drink it all, crying tears of gratitude.
say:30:1421408027:1.female: They'd probably drink it all, crying tears of gratitude.

choice_prompt:31:1421408027.source_cn: 他们多半也会感激涕零地一饮而尽吧。

choice_prompt:31:1421408027.female: They'd probably drink it all, crying tears of gratitude.

say:32:1421408028:1.text: Well, technically, you could bathe in it. My mother lived a long, vigorous life, and there's a pool full of Divine Dew here.
say:32:1421408028:1.source_cn: 不好说。你想，我那位尊贵的母亲有那样不朽的青春与力量，...
say:32:1421408028:1.male: Well, technically, you could bathe in it. My mother lived a long, vigorous life, and there's a pool full of Divine Dew here.
say:32:1421408028:1.female: Well, technically, you could bathe in it. My mother lived a long, vigorous life, and there's a pool full of Divine Dew here.

say:33:1421408029:1.text: Anyone who learns about it would start making connections, wouldn't they?
say:33:1421408029:1.source_cn: 只要知道这里有灵露池存在的人，多半都会产生因果关系的猜想吧？
say:33:1421408029:1.male: Anyone who learns about it would start making connections, wouldn't they?
say:33:1421408029:1.female: Anyone who learns about it would start making connections, wouldn't they?

say:34:1421408030:1.text: Stop with your conspiracy theories, Ravion. After all, you're the one who found out that this pool is used to store the egg essence.
say:34:1421408030:1.source_cn: 你就别做这种阴谋联想了。明明调查出来这个池子是储存蛋液...

say:35:1421408031:1.text: The dwarves' pipeline feeds directly into it. Seralyth handled the ingredient processing here, with Velara's help.
say:35:1421408031:1.source_cn: 矮人的提炼输送管道是直接注入此处，奈萨雷斯都是在这里进...

say:36:1421408032:1.text: You're the one who handed me the evidence, and now you're making jokes about it...
say:36:1421408032:1.source_cn: 这些还是你亲自把证据交到我手上的，现在又在开这种玩笑……

say:37:1421408033:1.text: Can't blame me for having a little fun. Maybe she decided to have a nice soak while she was at it. I'd do the same.
say:37:1421408033:1.source_cn: 那你也不能否认，她说不定一时兴起就会下去玩一会儿嘛——...

say:38:1421408034:1.text: ...So, what exactly did you want me to bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> for?
say:38:1421408034:1.male: ...So, what exactly did you want me to bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> for?
say:38:1421408034:1.female: ...So, what exactly did you want me to bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> for?

say:39:1421408035:1.text: Ah, yes. I've been checking on the progress in the Tenebris Court. There are some personal items in my mother's chambers—nothing of importance, but I'd like to take a few as mementos.
say:39:1421408035:1.source_cn: 啊，是我看到永夜圣庭的整理进度，我母亲的寝殿里或许有些...

say:40:1421408036:1.text: After all, I am her son. Even though I can't inherit her power and her property was confiscated, it wouldn't hurt to keep a few keepsakes, would it?
say:40:1421408036:1.source_cn: 毕竟我是她的亲生儿子嘛，就算权力没法继承，财产也被没收...

say:41:1421408037:1.text: Don't joke about that. Anything that belongs to you will be returned. You could just go and take them yourself if you really want them, couldn't you?
say:41:1421408037:1.source_cn: 别拿这种事说笑，该属于你的肯定都会交给你，而且这点东西...

choice_prompt:42:1421408037.text: Don't joke about that. Anything that belongs to you will be returned. You could just go and take them yourself if you really want them, couldn't you?
choice_prompt:42:1421408037.source_cn: 别拿这种事说笑，该属于你的肯定都会交给你，而且这点东西你自己直接过去拿不就行了？

say:43:1421408038:1.text: It was right to call you here. You're much more perceptive in this area.
say:43:1421408038:1.source_cn: 果然喊你来是正确的，在这方面你可要敏锐得多了。
say:43:1421408038:1.male: It was right to call you here. You're much more perceptive in this area.
say:43:1421408038:1.female: It was right to call you here. You're much more perceptive in this area.

say:44:1421408040:2.text: I'm legally the heir to my mother's title, and as much as I despise the idea, there will always be opportunists stirring things up behind me.
say:44:1421408040:2.source_cn: 毕竟我从法理上是我母亲的正统继承人，无论我本人意愿如何...
say:44:1421408040:2.male: I'm legally the heir to my mother's title, and as much as I despise the idea, there will always be opportunists stirring things up behind me.
say:44:1421408040:2.female: I'm legally the heir to my mother's title, and as much as I despise the idea, there will always be opportunists stirring things up behind me.

say:45:1421408041:1.text: If I just waltzed into the Queen's chambers to take things, people would definitely start raising questions.
say:45:1421408041:1.source_cn: 如果我还大大咧咧地前往女王的寝殿拿我自己的东西，那影响...
say:45:1421408041:1.male: If I just waltzed into the Queen's chambers to take things, people would definitely start raising questions.
say:45:1421408041:1.female: If I just waltzed into the Queen's chambers to take things, people would definitely start raising questions.

say:46:1421408042:1.text: So, for safety's sake, I invited the trustworthy Captain and his esteemed companion—the great Magister who helped save Sal'thorin—to act as witnesses.
say:46:1421408042:1.source_cn: 所以，安全起见，我邀请现任当权者与他的好朋友——地上的...

say:46:1421408042:1.female: So, for safety's sake, I invited the trustworthy Captain and his esteemed companion—the great Magister who helped save Sal'thorin—to act as witnesses.

say:47:1421408043:1.text: You still hold order in the city, Ravion. Don't start talking about authority as if you've lost it.
say:47:1421408043:1.source_cn: 明明现在仍然掌握城内秩序的人是你，别说什么当权不当权的话。

say:48:1421408044:1.text: Oh, I haven't forgotten. That's precisely why I abdicated my title. Now, if only I could resign from the responsibilities as well...
say:48:1421408044:1.source_cn: 不不，这就是我辞去头衔的最大原因，虽然要是能把工作也一...

say:49:1421408045:1.text: But let's save the politics for later.
say:49:1421408045:1.source_cn: 总之，这些重复了多次的交流我们私下再说。

say:50:1421408046:1.text: For now, I ask both of you to witness my sincerity, loyalty, obedience, and sincerity. This moment is of utmost significance.
say:50:1421408046:1.source_cn: 此时，我请求二位一同见证我的纯洁、忠诚、顺从与纯洁——...

choice_prompt:51:1421408046.text: For now, I ask both of you to witness my sincerity, loyalty, obedience, and sincerity. This moment is of utmost significance.
choice_prompt:51:1421408046.source_cn: 此时，我请求二位一同见证我的纯洁、忠诚、顺从与纯洁——这在各方面都是非常有意义的。

say:52:1421408047:1.text: Oh, come now, Merlin. You're an indispensable part of my plan; I can't let you abandon me here.
say:52:1421408047:1.source_cn: 别这样，你可是我计划中不可或缺的一部分，不能在这里抛弃我。
say:52:1421408047:1.male: Oh, come now, Merlin. You're an indispensable part of my plan; I can't let you abandon me here.
say:52:1421408047:1.female: Oh, come now, Merlin. You're an indispensable part of my plan; I can't let you abandon me here.

say:53:1421408049:1.text: Alright, time to head to my mother's chambers.
say:53:1421408049:1.source_cn: 好了，这里已经没什么事了，那么我们就去我母亲的寝殿吧！

say:54:1421408050:1.text: Wait! You're the only one guarding this place. What happens once you leave?
say:54:1421408050:1.source_cn: 等等！这里只有你一个人看守，你一走这里不就空了吗？

say:56:1421408051:1.text: No need to fret. People only stop by once every few days. By my estimates, no one else will be coming for another five days.
say:56:1421408051:1.source_cn: 放心放心，这里通常三五天才会来一个人，刚刚我已经把这五...

say:57:1421408052:1.text:
What kind of calculation is that...?
Never mind. Just wait here for a second. I'll go arrange for some guards to take over.
say:57:1421408052:1.source_cn: 这是什么算法……\n算了，你们在这等着，我去安排卫队，...

say:59:1421408053:1.text: Well, let him do his thing. I'm sure this place will be flooded with guards soon. Let's go.
